hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı: ```python import html import re STOP = {"the", "a", "is", "and"} def clean_tokens(text): text = html.unescape(text) text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text) return [w for w in re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower()) if w not in STOP] print(clean_tokens("

The lid is NOT tight & leaks

")) ```
